title: Introducing the FC Porto Fan Token (PORTO) Token Sale on Binance Launchpad!
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce the 23rd project on Binance Launchpad -  FC Porto Fan Token  (PORTO) . The token sale for FC Porto Fan Token will follow the  Launchpad   subscription format , with the recording of user BNB balances starting at 2021-11-06 00:00 AM (UTC).  Binance will record user BNB balances for 10 days from 2021-11-06 00:00 AM (UTC) to 2021-11-16 00:00 AM (UTC). The final BNB holding amount for each user will be determined as the average of the 10 days, using the Daily Average BNB Balance calculation previously announced  here . PORTO Token Sale Details:  Token Name: FC Porto Fan Token  (PORTO) Launchpad Hard Cap: 4,000,000 USD Hard Cap Per User: 10,000 USD (10,000 PORTO)  Total Token Supply: 40,000,000 PORTO Total Tokens Allocated to Binance Launchpad: 4,000,000 PORTO (10% of Total Token Supply) Public Sale Token Price: 1 PORTO = 1 USD (price in BNB will be determined prior to subscription) Token Sale Format: Subscription Supported Sessions: BNB only Subscription Timeline: Preparation Period  2021-11-06 00:00 AM (UTC) to 2021-11-16 00:00 AM (UTC): During this period, user BNB balances will be calculated in  hourly snapshots  for each day over a 10-day period. Your final average daily BNB balance over these 10 days will determine the maximum amount of BNB that you can commit later on. Subscription Period  2021-11-16 06:00 AM (UTC) to 2021-11-16 09:00 AM (UTC): Subscription will open at this time for all eligible users for a 3 hour period. Users must also sign the Token Purchase Agreement at the same time, prior to committing their BNB. Please note that once committed, your BNB will be  locked  and you will not be able to redeem or access any other functions such as transfers, withdrawals or trading until final token distribution.  Calculation Period  2021-11-16 09:00 AM (UTC) to 2021-11-16 10:00 AM (UTC): Subscription closes and token allocation calculation begins. Final Token Distribution  2021-11-16 10:00 AM (UTC): Your final token allocation will be calculated and the corresponding BNB will be deducted from your already-locked BNB amount. Once deducted, your PORTO and BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet.  To learn more about FC Porto Fan Token  (PORTO), read Binance Research's in-depth report  here . Further information:  Launchpad Subscription Format FAQ Launchpad Detailed Allocation Calculation and BNB Deduction Rules FC Porto Fan Token Project Links: Website:  https://www.fcporto.pt/ Fan Token Page:  https://www.binance.com/en/fan-token Twitter:  https://twitter.com/fcporto Reminder: Users need to complete their account verification and also be from an eligible jurisdiction to participate in this token sale.  * Users from the following countries or regions will not be able to participate in token sales on the Binance Launchpad platform:  Belarus, People's Republic of China, Democratic Republic of Congo, Cuba, Iraq, Iran, North Korea, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, United States of America and its territories (American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands), Zimbabwe.
